name: nginx-multisite
description: Configures Nginx for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, including static content, vhost management, firewall and SSH hardening, Fail2ban, sysctl settings, and development self-signed certificates.

name: cache
description: Installs and enables Memcached and Redis, creates the Redis log directory, configures Redis on port 6379 with password protection, and applies a post-install configuration workaround.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs Python and PostgreSQL prerequisites, deploys the FastAPI application from GitHub, creates its virtual environment and database, writes environment configuration, and runs it via systemd and Uvicorn on port 8000.
